links.comparator_used: GPT-4 without context, relying on its internal (training) knowledge
links.outcome: Coherence of treatment recommendations with the 2024 WHO CHB guidelines, rated by seven physicians; also preciseness/clarity, completeness, textual correctness
links.effect: Guideline coherence rose from 51% to 91%; preciseness and clarity +54%, completeness of incorporating case vignette information +24%, textual correctness +12%
links.quote: Using GPT-4 with context increased the coherence of the treatment recommendations with the new 2024 guidelines from 51% to 91% compared to GPT-4 without context.

design_hint: retrieval grounding added to an existing tool
